book.name: 1 Emi iKorinti
book.title: Afɛ mgbi iPol ongwi ababɔmbi ama onoyɛyɛ Emi iKorinti

content: Emi iKrestu kwu eka elikwɔ
Kini inggisɛ mi idzidzɛ ema sulu okakewo yi oka ma, o ka kyon kwelikwɔ mbi ama oye Imgbasho ba ntona naa o ka kyon kɛ mbi emi odzimgbasho?
Ema ye dafi li emi osaan ka gbɔ ɛsɛ ikwɔ lo? Ma ni li ema ka gbɔ ɛsɛ ikwɔ wali, li ambulu odzɛ ntonɛ ngwi ema ka mɛ gbɛ ba dɛɛn?
Ema ye dafi eyi kawa gbɔ engyesɔ ikwɔ wɛ? Se ka fwikye ungwɔ ongwi ɛsɛ nɛ!
Nghanɛ, kini ema sulu okakewo itɔ ntonɛ yɔ, yeba ni li inggisɛ nfyumfye mi iKrestu ba kpaa nu ma dulun no gbiikwɔ nani!
N le gbɔdzɛ nɛ ikye onu ema ayiwi. Ema sulu inggisɛ onyi ongwu nkwiinɛ mɛ ogbɔ ama onoyɛyɛ ikwɔ mi idzidzɛ ema baa?
Nghaduu engwuneka mi ifu iKrestu le kye ewoma kwelikwɔ mbi ama onoyɛyɛ ba!
Ikyegbɛɛ ema sulu okakewo mi idzidzɛ ema nɛ i tso saan gbɛɛ odzɛ ngha ema. Tatase ni ongwunema kyɔ ema obube ngha onu ema kye ewema kɛ mbi emi esɛ baa? Tatase ni inggisɛ kyɔɔkyɔ ema ogye lo?
Otimbi ngha yɔ, ema abuema li kyɔ ogye di kyɔ ewema obube kpaa.
Ema ye dafi ama otimbali ka kaka udɛ Imgbasho ba ma wɛ? Ni a ka kpagya ema wo ba ama okyɔ amah hona emi angwula hona ama ola yi owinggisɛ hona owagbai engyulɔ hona amah idza, ongyulɔ ola yi ongyulɔ,
hona emumyi, hona ama okyɔ nggwɔ, hona ama ofyɛbyɛ, hona ama ombe inggisɛ iyi, naadi ama ogbɛ inggisɛ ungwɔ mi abumfye duu ka kaka esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho ba.
Li ngha ngwi ema angbeka nose dzɛ aali. Kpaa a kyi sholu ema, a nu ema yɛɛ saan di gye emyɛmyɛ mi iyi mgbi Otsɛ iYesu iKrestu ikpewo Onodzi mgbi Imgbasho mgbi eyi.
Ka gbaamah ba
<<A nu ani ofɛ okyɔ alungwɔ duu>> kpaa li alungwɔ duu sulu abɔ oyaaya ba. <<A nu ani ofɛ okyɔ alungwɔ duu,>> kpaa n ka yama nu unkonyi gbɛ ani sɔ ba.
<<Ungwogye dzɛ ikye ifu, ifu di dzɛ ikye ungwogye>> nghaduu Imgbasho ka dzili ma duu. Ikpewo dzɛ ikye amah ba, kpaa li ikye mgbi Otsɛ nli otsungwɔ ikpewo nani.
Imgbasho kyile Otsɛ mi ikwu mi abumfye mgban, o dika kyile eyi kpaa.
Ema yagba ye dafi ewo mgbi ema li alewo mgbi iKrestu ma wɛ? Nghama li ayin nin kye alewo mgbi iKrestu kwokyi yi mgbi owagbaii? Onoka lo!
Ema ye dafi inggisɛ nkye ewon kwokyi yi owagbai yɔ, o yɛɛ ungwonyi yan mi ikpewo ma wɛ? Bana Afɛ lɔ gbɛɛ, <<Ama efa ka yɛɛ ikpewo onyi.>>
Nghaduu inggisɛ nkye ewon kwokyi yi Otsɛ yɔ, o yɛɛ ungwonyi yan mi onodzi.
Dulu abɔ mi amah na. Alobube angbeka duu ni inggisɛ kyɔ kpaa li kwokyi yi ikpewo mgban ba, kpaa inggisɛ nkyɔ amah yɔ, o kyɔ ikpewo mgban obube.
Ema ye dafi ikpewo mgbi ema li ozu mgbi Onodzi Osaan, nwodzɛ mbi ema, ngwi ema gbɛ mbi Imgbasho na baa? Ema li mgbi ewema ba,
a gya ema gyaagya mi mmya okwukwo. Nghanɛ kye ikpewo mgbi ema kyidɔ nka nu Imgbasho mmwɛ mani.
